title: V-JEPA 2
description: Self-supervised video models for understanding, prediction, and planning.

title: CALM
description: A continuous VAE frame and a consistency-model sampler replace stacked RVQ tokens in audio language models.
coverAlt: A waveform is encoded by a VAE into one continuous vector per frame, replacing stacked RVQ levels; a language model and consistency head then sample the next vector.

title: Small-Scale Experiments
description: Scaling laws for language models only appear once hyperparameters are tuned to the fully optimized frontier at each scale.
coverAlt: A log-log plot of loss against model scale: a wide scatter of tuning runs at small scale narrows toward a fitted scaling-law curve as scale grows, marking the best attainable loss.
